title: Hounslow West Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in Hounslow West.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: West Middlesex University Hospital (Twickenham Road, Isleworth TW7 6AF) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Hounslow West station: ~2.5 miles east; take bus 235 or 117 along Bath Road and London Road towards Isleworth (~20-25 mins), or walk east along Bath Road and Hanworth Road (~45 mins). Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St George's Hospital (Blackshaw Road, Tooting SW17 0QT). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: West Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre (co-located at West Middlesex University Hospital, Twickenham Road TW7 6AF) — open 24 hours daily for urgent injuries and illnesses that do not require full resuscitation care. 3. Local Hazard Notes: The River Crane flows along the western edge of Hounslow; parkland corridors and roads near Cranford and Baber Bridge carry surface flood risks during extreme storms. Major road junctions along the A4 (Bath Road) and A30 present traffic hazards during grid failures. 4. Supplies: Bath Road near Hounslow West station and the pedestrianised Hounslow High Street (near Hounslow Central and East) contain multiple large chemists and supermarkets for bottled water and medication. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
